title: The Beacon Keeper's Repentance
logline: A notorious corsair tactician living under a quiet alias as a lighthouse engineer is blackmailed by their former syndicate to reveal patrol blind spots or face public exposure.

roles.description: A solitary navigation beacon engineer living under an assumed name; formerly the chief navigator for an infamous pirate fleet.
An ambitious raider officer who tracked down their former mentor to demand flight corridor ambush vectors.
A thorough sector safety inspector conducting routine audits of remote automated beacons.
An isolated navigation lighthouse anchoring a hazardous asteroid shipping lane.
A fast strike ship dispatched by the raiders to force the keeper's compliance.

public_situation: Shipping companies report intermittent telemetry dropouts from the outer navigation spire in {system}, prompting routine maintenance inquiries.
private_truth: The keeper is a reformed corsair tactician whose old cartel is threatening to broadcast their true identity to prosecutors unless they reveal patrol blind spots.

beats.public_change: The navigation spire's warning pulse flickers erratically, slowing commercial traffic through the debris field.

missions.reason: The inspector hires a contracted courier to deliver replacement focal lenses to the solitary keeper before filing a formal service violation.
missions.private_fact: She has grown suspicious of the keeper's spotless forged papers and requested a background archive verification.

beats.public_change: Unmarked raider reconnaissance probes are detected shadowing the navigation lane.

missions.reason: The keeper hires the pilot to retrieve an old encrypted memory drive from a dead drop in a nearby hollow rock before the cartel extracts it.
missions.private_fact: The drive contains the cartel's internal extortion ledger, which the keeper kept as insurance when they abandoned piracy.

beats.public_change: A corsair skiff docks near the spire pylon, threatening to broadcast the keeper's warrant dossier.

missions.reason: The keeper hires the pilot to eliminate the cartel skiff before the lieutenant can transmit the blackmail broadcast to the inspector.
missions.private_fact: The keeper is willing to sacrifice their savings and liberty to prevent the cartel from staging another massacre in the lane.

player_choice.prompt: With the cartel skiff neutralized, the pilot holds the keeper's extortion drive and true identity records.

options.label: Destroy the records, protecting the keeper's new life and the beacon
Deliver the records to the inspector to arrest the keeper and clear the cartel bounty
Sell the extortion ledger back to the cartel for a heavy ransom

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot eliminates the skiff and destroys the incriminating past records.
resolutions.summary: {role:beacon_keeper} continues their quiet watch over {role:navigation_spire}. The shipping lane remains safe, and the cartel loses track of the defector.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot destroyed a pirate skiff, protecting a solitary beacon keeper's quiet retirement.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot delivers the records to the inspector, bringing down the keeper.
resolutions.summary: {role:harbor_inspector} arrests {role:beacon_keeper} for decades of piracy. The spire falls dark until a relief crew arrives, disrupting transit.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot handed old corsair logs to inspectors, sending an honest beacon engineer to prison.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot sells the extortion ledger back to the cartel.
resolutions.summary: The cartel recovers their extortion archives and executes {role:beacon_keeper} off-screen. The spire is abandoned to pirate monitoring.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot sold an extortion dossier back to raiders, leaving a lighthouse keeper to their fate.

resolutions.summary: {role:beacon_keeper} yields to cartel threats, sabotaging the spire beacon. Three freighters are ambushed, and {role:harbor_inspector} is demoted.

loose_threads.detail: A supply clerk notes that the beacon keeper's retirement pension was quietly funded by a maritime welfare society in another sector.
The corsair skiff's communications module uses an encryption algorithm identical to standard customs enforcement hardware.

radio_hooks: Navigation warnings issued after outer spire telemetry flickers in {system}.
Harbor police announce increased patrols around remote automated navigational beacons.
Shipping guilds report isolated pirate skiff sightings near asteroid convergence corridors.

voice_direction.beacon_keeper: Soft, gravelly, and speaks with long silences as if unaccustomed to human conversation. Never mentions his former ship names.
voice_direction.cartel_lieutenant: Sneering, familiar, and speaks with casual cruelty. Refuses to acknowledge that their fleet has been weakened by losses.
voice_direction.harbor_inspector: Brisk, bureaucratic, and constantly types into a tablet. Becomes defensive when questioned about inspector staffing shortages.
